messages:
alex: heads up — we got reports that the oncall wasn't paged overnight. incidentbot shows webhooks sent but notifier-proxy returned errors and pages never left the system. anyone on infra awake?
ops-bot: Incidentbot: webhook_delivery_attempts=12, last_status=502 Bad Gateway -> retries exhausted :warning:
mike: confirmed from a customer SRE: missed page at ~02:10 UTC, they escalated.
sara: digging into notifier-proxy logs now. early snippet looks like:
```
[2026-04-02T02:09:56Z] POST /v1/notify 502 Bad Gateway - upstream_timeout
[2026-04-02T02:09:58Z] POST /v1/notify 502 Bad Gateway - connection_reset
[2026-04-02T02:10:04Z] POST /v1/notify 502 Bad Gateway - upstream_timeout
```
julia (oncall): I saw the Slack thread but never received a PagerDuty page. No PD alert in my queue. :eyes:
alex: hmm — incidentbot -> notifier-proxy delivered, proxy returned 502s, and our suppressor flipped a global mute key which prevented further pages. looks like a bad suppressor interaction rather than incidentbot itself.
mike: can you confirm suppressor behavior? we had a config change pushed around 02:05.
sara: yes — suppressor increments the same suppression key for any upstream 5xx. code excerpt:
```
// suppressor.js
if (resp.status >= 500) {
  suppressState.increment(muteKey)
}
```
That means transient 502s from PagerFlow cause the channel to be suppressed the same as manual mutes. bad.
julia (oncall): customer was impacted, I had to manually page the oncall at 02:22 UTC via PD web UI. PD acked.
alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) sara — rollback/patch suppressor to only treat non-retryable 5xx as suppress, 2) mike — enable fallback route to pd-fallback.internal so pages bypass notifier-proxy, 3) julia — confirm any missed incidents manually paged, 4) alex — open high-priority ticket for notifier-proxy/PagerFlow.
mike: enabled fallback route at 02:25 UTC (pd-fallback.internal). pages started going through, no 502s seen for the route.
sara: pushed quick patch and released to prod: only increment suppress when header x-nonretryable=true or on explicit manual mute. diff:
```
- if (resp.status >= 500) suppressState.increment(muteKey)
+ if (resp.status >= 500 && resp.headers['x-nonretryable'] === 'true') suppressState.increment(muteKey)
```
Rolling back full-suppress behavior now.
ops-bot: Incidentbot: webhook_delivery_retries_successful - all queued retries delivered after route switch :white_check_mark:
julia (oncall): marking incident as mitigated in PD. will add customer impact and timeline in the follow-up ticket.
alex: post-incident actions: - full RCA (owner: alex) - revert fallback route after notifier-proxy fix (owner: mike) - add metric/alert: notifier-proxy 5xx -> suppressor increments > 1/min (owner: sara) - add e2e test that simulates transient 502s to ensure suppressor doesn't mute system-wide. please ack owners.
mike: acked for fallback revert and verification.
sara: acked for metric + patch. will add unit + integration tests.
julia (oncall): customer notified, incident tracker updated. thanks. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks team. if you see any other missed pages, drop them here so we can backfill.
